title: Prince Family Paper
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight and Michael plan to infiltrate Prince Family Paper, leading to humorous interactions and uncertainties about their success. The episode also features discussions about Hillary Swank's attractiveness, a car accident, and Michael contemplating sharing sensitive information with David, with outcomes left unresolved.
